A dynamic approach is needed for exact estimation of the mode shape at low-frequency modes. Signal decomposition techniques and spectral analysis were adapted in this paper. Since the signal quality is weak, it is needed to identify the low-frequency mode prior to spectral analysis. The power spectral density is used to process dominant modes which indicate centre frequencies in the spectrum. Variational mode decomposition is proposed in place of empirical mode decomposition so as to provide a better-quality way of analysis of low-frequency mode and mode shape determination, and it is tested on real-time data from the power grid.

articleTitle: Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Control
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Earth, the third planet from the sun is the only planet on which life is known to exist. Seventy percent of the earth is covered by oceans. These oceans have been playing a very crucial role in transporting of goods even before the road. At the same time it cannot be ignored the possibilities of the negative role of the oceans- a very serious threat to human society and damage of man-made infrastructure through the natural phenomenon such as hurricanes and tsunamis, the latest being Hudhud in Visakhapatnam and Nilam in Chennai. Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUV) and Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROV), are considered as marine robots which are very useful for study of ocean resources such as aquaculture, offshore mining, ocean survey etc.,. This paper considers the dynamic modeling of an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) which is used to track the AUV in the presence of ocean currents and other underwater environmental disturbances. Model Predictive Control (MPC) has been attempted on AUV for control purpose. The main advantage of using MPC is it can easily handle multi input multi output systems very effectively. Constraints on inputs, states and outputs can also be considered using this technique. It has the ability to handle model mismatch and disturbances. Sensor noise can be estimated using filter and Kalman filtering plays an important role in AUV navigation. AUV sensors play an important role in data collection and remote sensing. Global Positioning satellite (GPS) may not work in underwater environment for remote sensing. Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor is used to find position of a vehicle and it may also helpful for remote sensing. Mathematical modeling and MPC formulations are the contributions of this paper. The results presented in this paper can be summarized in three points as dynamic modeling of AUV, stability issues, and formulation of MPC. All the simulations are carried out in MATLAB environment. These results help to explain the AUV control concept which is essential for ocean studies to monitor the underwater environment.

articleTitle: Integration of Solar Photovoltaic with Battery Storage for Power Conditioning of Dynamic Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The solar photovoltaic system plays vital role in the modern DC micro grid systems due to clean power and freely available in nature. The abundant and day variability solar power is intermittent in nature. The availability of solar power efficiently and effectively utilizes with the use of battery storage systems. In this work, the solar photovoltaic with the battery storage system is investigated. The stochastic nature of solar power is extracted using intelligent controller based maximum power point tracking method. The battery storage system is interface with the DC link through the bi-directional DC-DC converter. The battery charge controller is implemented with the proportional and integral control. The solar photovoltaic with battery storage system provides the flexible power to the load continuously based on the battery state of the charge. The dynamic variations in the source and load performance are simulated in the MATLAB-Simulink software.

articleTitle: Improving Reliability Performance and Global Benchmarking through PEER
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Power Outages are common in any developing nation leading to poor reliability and power quality issues. Though grid modernization is under progress in many world nations, occurrences of blackouts and grid failures are still common. The real challenge for any nation lies in building a reliable and resilient energy infrastructure to combat frequent outages and operational failures. While efforts are being taken for the implementation of energy infrastructure transformation, there is a lack of market instruments or tools that help in analyzing and assessing the grid performance. Considering this and to create a common language for stakeholders in the energy space, a performance based, and data-driven program is developed called PEER - PERFORMANCE EXCELLENCE IN ELECTRICITY RENEWAL. PEER helps Cities, Utilities (Power distributing companies), Critical infrastructure campuses (Hospitals, Datacenters, Airports, Manufacturing Units etc.) and Transit systems (Metros) in assessing their electrical infrastructure using PEER indicators. This paper talks about the PEER reliability indicators and its benefits, with a case study on Chattanooga Electric power board.

articleTitle: Prediction of Core Loss and Temperature in Gapped Core Shunt Reactors Using Reluctance Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Shunt reactors are employed to compensate the reactor power generation and resulting voltage rise issues by virtue of large capacitive currents in long transmission lines. Distributed gapped core construction is extensively used for shunt reactors in which the magnetic core is divided into several laminated packets separated by fragments made of non-magnetic material. Presence of significant volume of air gaps in magnetic flux path generates superfluous losses in the reactor core. Three dimensional FEM calculations are widely used numerical methods for accurate prediction of loss components in the reactor, but it necessitates high computational resources like sophisticated workstations and skilled specialists. This paper aims to predict the core losses and temperature in a gapped core shunt reactor using a simple and fast reluctance network based analytical method and it is verified for two extreme ratings of 1Φ, 3 limb reactors. The reliability of the results are validated by comparison with FEM simulations.

articleTitle: Proposing a System Model for Safe Device Charging
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Energy delivery of an electrical device performs a first-rate role in every digital gadget as it controls, regulates and distributes DC strength for the gadget. In this paper a variable DC energy source is being used with an external safety circuit. The Dc source is designed by Arduino with pulse width modulation (PWM) based manipulate circuit along with MOSFET for switching operation. The principle characteristic of our project work is to adjust the output voltage by means of PWM manipulation and by controlling the PWM ripple voltage. In order to do that the pulse width is varying with the modifications inside the DC output voltage stage which will change the pulse width that will arise an output voltage. As a result, the output voltage may be numerous respectively with the versions of load.

articleTitle: ECG Tracking And Analysis Using Bluetooth and Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Patients in most of the cases cannot be rushed to hospitals quickly because of various problems such as, traffic, lack of fast transport service etc. So, this project aims at designing a mobile ECG monitoring system which can be used at normal households. The main objective is to make the system cost effective and more compact. This project comprises of basic steps of signal acquisition, pre-processing, analyzing and providing the result which will be explained in detail in the methodology.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic supplied push pull converter for wireless power transfer applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Transferring power wirelessly is widely used for transmitting power from power supply to different versatile power devices. With its quick advancement, an ever increasing number of utilizations have showed up in biomedical implants, hand phones and electrical vehicles. The system has a resonant tank innate attributes, due to this it's very difficult to attain a high gain in voltage. This paper proposes a PV supplied push pull converter to achieve high output voltage which incorporate high frequency transformer (HF). The highlights of this converter are that the step-up ratio of a HF transformer is high and primary side bears relatively less number of switches. Duty cycle control strategy is used for switching converter switches. This technique enables the converter to get good efficiency while work with a variable voltage increase over a wide range. The proposed circuit is simulated in open and closed loop using P, PI and PID. The simulation results are verified experimentally and the output of proposed converter is free from ripples and has regulated output voltage.

articleTitle: Designing of Digital Odometer Processing for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Vehicle Odometer system, designed to measure the distance traveled and the instantaneous velocity of the vehicle. An Odometer display system includes a control unit connected to an Ignition Keyon Switch of a vehicle to obtain the accumulated mileage by accumulating a pulse signal produced according to the running of the vehicle. The control unit stores odometer data in an EEPROM. The control unit also reads the odometer data stored in the BBRAM when the ignition key on switch is operated. The Digital Odometer is designed using the MPC55XX automotive controller to improve reliability and overall performance. As per the Functional Requirement for a Digital Odometer, the control strategy is developed for Odometer Processing. Digital Odometer has high accuracy with better visualization with more functions with less cost. This paper is going to propose the Processing of Digital odometer with improved speed of operation.

articleTitle: Segmentation and Text extraction from Document Images: Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Segmentation and text extraction from complex document image helps in analyzing, storing, retrieving and auto indexing of required information. In this paper, we considered 23 existing methods of segmentation and text extraction for complex document images. After review of the existing methods, we found that connected component method [1],[2],[5],[8],[10],[13] are more suitable for segmentation of text and non-text from document and also LSTM &RNN found that potential methods for extraction of text from complex document[15].

articleTitle: Estimation of the Collision Risk of Autonomous Vehicle using Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper the clustering of different road-shapes like straight road or T-junction (i.e. three way road) or cross junction (i.e. four way road) has been presented using TFSOM×SOM algorithm. A trajectory path of a vehicle on different shapes of roads has been drawn which describes the degree of risk of collision on the road. The main aim of this work is to classify the different road-shapes and also to anticipate the possibility of the density of objects on the basis of different kinds of shapes of the road. The dependency of risk of collision is on the density of objects available on the road i.e. if number of available objects is more, the risk of collision is excessive and vice-versa. This prediction of high risk and low risk of collision can be used to set an alarm to alert driving system to avoid collision.

articleTitle: Detection of Heart Rate Using Reflectance Mode Photoplethysmography
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper represents the working of a low-cost design of heart beat monitoring device using reflectance mode Photoplethysmography (PPG). PPG can provide information about the changes in cardiac activity as well as aid in earlier non-invasive diagnostics and is known for its simple construction, ease of use and cost effectiveness. The PPG device is divided into three parts. First is the detection of pulses through the fingertip using light dependent resistor and red LED. Second, the signal is passed to the signal processing unit for amplification, filtering and digitizing. Finally, the heart rate is calculated and displayed on the computer using LabView. The device is used to detect the variation of heart rate in sleep apnea condition.

articleTitle: Neutral Voltage Balancing Of Three Level Neutral-Clamped Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multilevel inverter's most commonly used configuration of neutral point clamped inverter have vast applications with high power areas, due to its various benefits such as, small dv/dt and total harmonic distortion. However neutral potential balancing problems can be seen in NPC inverters. Various balancing techniques are discussed in past for balancing, but they have vulnerable balancing ability at low PFs and high modulation index. In proposed strategy, the switching vectors that vary the potential at neutral point are changed with N and P type small vectors that do not have effect on neutral point. And for balancing potential at neutral point, the zero and medium vectors are used.

articleTitle: Low Cost Automation for Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the area of farming, use of appropriate method of irrigation is crucial and it is clearly defined that drip irrigation is highly commercial and effective. In the normal conventional drip irrigation system, the farmers have to regularly keep an eye on irrigation schedule and timetable, which is varied for diverse crops. The central theme of the paper makes the irrigation automated. The use of low budget sensors and the small control unit makes this venture a low budget solution, which can be subscribed even by a meager agriculturalist. This idea is best suited for the places where scarcity of water takes place and it, also, has to be used in restricted quantity. Any states of India and the rest of the world can afford this modest and low budget solution for irrigation and obtain good yield on Crops.

articleTitle: Energy Conservation in an Educational Institution – Through Lighting Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The sheer rise in the usage of electricity each year in India has led the government to take up steps on the aspect of energy efficiency. To deal with the environmental issues concerning climate change and the issue of energy consumption, one of the common practice is by ensuring the use of electricity in an efficient manner and minimizing the wastage of energy consumption. The basic idea is to cut down the overall energy demand. One of the common practice to achieve energy management is to optimize the lighting system. This paper presents an evaluation on the efficiency of energy consumption for the lighting system in the Electrical and Electronics Department, Manipal Institute of Technology and propose a new lighting design with compliance to IS 3646 Standards to achieve the optimal use of energy. In order to achieve this goal, the bad practices were found out. Also, the payback period is determined according to the proposed system. The study of the data showed that the usage of LED lights could provide energy saving up to 32% as compared to conventional fluorescent lamps.

articleTitle: A Novel Two-Stage Hybrid T-type Five-Level Transformerless Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a new two-stage hybrid T-type five-level inverter for 1-φ grid connected photovoltaic applications (PV). The new topology comprises three-level boost converter (3LBC) and hybrid T-type five-level inverter. The 3LBC balances the capacitor voltages by employing simple control algorithm and also improves power conversion efficiency by lowering voltage stress. The sinusoidal level shifted pulse width modulation (SLS-PWM) scheme is used to operate the inverter at different power factor conditions without affecting the transitions in common mode voltage (CMV). Moreover, the leakage current produced by the parasitic capacitance of the PV panel is minimized by providing common mode path to the inverter. Furthermore, it also minimizes the voltage rating of the power semiconductor switches, total harmonic distortion and the filter size. Simulation results are presented to validate the capabilities of the proposed inverter.

articleTitle: Development of Solar Power Optimization Tool using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Solar Panel installation plays a vital role in optimum PV energy generation. The angle of solar panel installation matters to get optimum solar radiation which results in better power production. The angle basically tilt angle is directly correlated with latitude which changes with location around earth. But to optimize power access from the panel right tilt angle should be set up during installation; also it requires angle tuning over the time. This paper will present a unique way to adapt the challenges resulting in a cost effective solution for solar panel installation in order to optimize the solar power generation in a particular location.

articleTitle: A Single-Photodiode Coherent ONU Receiver for 25G Line-Rate PON Application
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Passive optical network (PON) employing coherent receiver is a promising technology for future high-speed optical access network. However, the commonly used phase and polarization diverse coherent receiver for long-haul communication is not suitable for cost stringent access network. Therefore, low-complexity (and thereby low-cost) coherent receiver design for access network becomes an attracting research field in current years. In this paper, we propose a simple heterodyne single-polarization coherent receiver by using a 3-dB coupler and a single-ended photodiode to realize a 25-Gb/s optical network unit (ONU) receiver. To make the receiver polarization-insensitive, Alamouti-coded dual polarization 14-Gbaud QPSK transmitter is used at the optical line terminal (OLT) side. By means of computer simulation, it is confirmed that the proposed ONU receiver allows a high split ratio of 1:512 for 30-km transmission length whereas a lower splitting ratio of 1:16 enable the use of long-reach PON (LR-PON) of 100 km.

articleTitle: User Controlled Precision Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper is an attempt to recognize and test the intelligent and smart irrigation system. Water requirement for outdoor plants in commercial agriculture domain calls for optimum usage of water due to the monstrous worldwide water crisis. For domestic applications in urban localities, often people who have plants face a problem of watering them when they are out on vacation or on duty. The proposed method uses a smartphone to check the atmospheric temperature, relative humidity and soil moisture of the potted plants. The owner thus has the option to put ON or OFF a water pump using a Mobile Application based on the monitored parameters. It is a cost effective, user controlled precision irrigation service. The readings of the sensors are recorded twice a day and the results of the experimental set up shows that a typical Periwinkle (Catharanthus roseus) plant consumes approximately 250 ml of water per day in a Tropical region.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Incorporation of Solar Energy System and it’s Control Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Performance optimization, operative efficiency, and a smart-grid system dependable are main criterion. We consider IC technique for tracking MPP in PV array. This proposed method is precise, vigorous and simple to model the PV array .The copy based controller is designed corresponding reference signal for PWM generation of the converter would be calibrated to get maximum power. The proposed System is design on MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Structure of Boost DC and Multilevel Inverter with Reduced Switches for 7 level
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Requirement of power saving is essential for the present scenario. Conventional Multilevel Inverters (MLI) are having more switches, but they have wide range of attractive applications with effective results. The research article presents a novel structure of reduced switch single phase seven level multilevel inverter. Each DC source in the proposed structure is integrated with DC boost converter. Therefore, the proposed structure ensures the less switching losses, reduced size and cost of the structure. Comparative study of proposed MLI and conventional cascaded MLI is presented with various logical analyses of pulse width modulation (PWM) methods. The performance analysis in terms of THD is presented with the comparison of cascaded MLI and proposed MLI. Simulation design and validation of the comparative analysis is carried with MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: A Comparative Fault Analysis in Series Compensated Line during Power Swing
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A Power swing block is very much necessary to avoid unintentional operation for modern distance relay at the time of power swing condition. However, in presence of power swing condition if any fault occurs then the relay immediately operate to maintain security for the apparatus.In series compensated line during power swing the fault detection is very complicated due to capacitor in the protection circuit. In this paper by negative sequence component of current the classification and location of symmetrical and unsymmetrical fault is easily possible. The data simulated by EMTDC/PSCAD software in a series compensated line for power swing condition and is tested and found to be accurate.

articleTitle: Efficient Modelling Techniques for J-Type Thermocouples in Electric Vehicle Battery Temperature Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper an analysis of different interpolation techniques are done to show the efficient ways for determining the temperature characteristics of the J-Type thermocouples in electric vehicle batteries for temperature measurements since temperature variations considerably affects the performance of the battery. The numerical analysis and neural network techniques are used. A comparative study on the basis of the error percentages is done to show the accuracies of different techniques from the actual experimental data.

articleTitle: Broadband Microwave Cloaking Analysis Under FDTD in Visible Frequency Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Full wave at microwave range under FDTD(Finite Difference Time Domain) analysis is done for an invisible cloak is designed under software environment, the cylindrical electromagnetic cloak's performance is verified with its simulation within its cloak structure and behavioral study is carried out for different light's wavelength in its visible spectrum range when the light get incident on the 2D cylindrical cloak which is invisible in nature in order to make the structure works under optical frequency region which get processed with parameter changes (differently) namely cloak's inner and outer radii with varying cell size and number of steps that tend to affect the parameters of the structure.

articleTitle: High Performance Visible-Range Photodetector for Wide-Bandwidth Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: We present a theoretical model of front illuminated GaN Optical Field Effect Transistor (OPFET) with floating gate accounting for photovoltaic and photoconductive effects. Our simulation results reveal desirable photodetector characteristics in the visible-region at the modulation frequencies in the microwave to terahertz range. The device exhibits superior performance than many of the photodetectors working at microwave or terahertz frequencies. The device has a great potential for wide bandwidth applications.

articleTitle: Application of Hydroelectric Cell for LED Lamp
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Hydroelectric cells are a new form of renewable energy where we are using water as an energy source. This cell is made of Lithium Substituted Magnesium Ferrite, a nanoporous material in the form of a circular pellet. Zinc and Silver are used as electrodes where Zinc works as anode and Silver as a cathode. The electric charges are generated due to the redox reaction. Water gets absorbed by the material and this physisorption of water generates Hydronium and Hydroxide ions. The Hydroxide ion moves towards Zinc electrode where it forms Zinc Hydroxide and releases electrons and Hydronium ion moves towards Silver electrode and releases Hydrogen gas. Due to this redox reaction charges get developed and current starts flowing. We are working on RKJ51 whose 1-inch diameter pellet gives 920mV open cell voltage and 82mA peak current. As the voltage provided by Hydroelectric cell is not sufficient to power a single LEDs hence there is a need of boosting the voltage. We are making a voltage booster circuit which can boost the voltage of Hydroelectric circuit and can make it useful for LED lighting.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for a Smart Coconut Dryer
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The most essential operation in the post-harvest agricultural preservation process is drying. Drying also protects agricultural products from pests and microbes. Unlike other dryers, the proposed dryer is capable of working in all weather conditions. In this paper, ANSYS based stress and temperature analysis for the proposed dryer is presented. Stress analysis for the circular and rectangular tray is simulated and results are obtained for a full load and half load conditions. In temperature analysis, the streamline flow of hot air is determined. From streamline flow temperature and pressure variations with respect to velocities is obtained. The parameters like temperature inside the dryer and moisture content of the coconut pulp are monitored and controlled effectively. This makes the system smart and efficient.

articleTitle: Video Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Video Stabilization is a technology used to rectify the blurry motion of camera while capturing a video. It is an optimization technology which is proposed to eliminate the video shakiness. To achieve this image motion has to be measured by multi layer gray projection method. Multi layer gray projection method is introduced to evaluate scaling motion, translation and rotation among the target image and the reference image. Differential gray projection is used to measure the relative image translation and the resulting high-grade projection will help us to find the projection centre for the round projection and ring projection. Then find the rotational values and values obtained by scaling among the target frames and the reference frames by performing ring and circular projection. Keywords- multilayer gray projection, translation, rotation, scaling

articleTitle: Analysis And Synthesis of Image Using Wavelet Transform and Compression Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, deal with image for analyze and compress without loss of brightness by wavelet transformation with various compression methods. Generally, image or signal can be analysed either frequency or time domain. In wavelet transformation the image can be considered in frequency and time domain. In this technique image can be compressed or reduced about 70% of original image without loss of brightness. The wavelet transformation is performed for small and large data. It can be chunked signal from large signal and examined for small signal without maximum loss of threshold.

articleTitle: Improved Thermal Management in Dry Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Dry type transformer is a popular choice for application wherein flame-retarding, self-extinguishing and low- maintenance is desired; e.g. wind turbines, underground- substations etc. As their makeup involves no-oil, the cooling of coils is essentially by natural convection of air. With increase in demand for higher-ratings and stringent limitation on coil temperature rise, convectional design of thermal management has severe limitation on meeting these requirements. Also, conventional approach of thermal management leads to increased equipment cost and foot-print. This paper discusses a novel methodology of improving the heat dissipation in dry transformers with low- cost retrofit-able systems that increase the heat dissipation rate significantly.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Diagnosis using a Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Machine Learning turns the extensive collection of raw healthcare data into information that can help to make informed decision and prediction. This research named fine-tune prediction (FTP) model aims to identify significant features and incorporate hybrid classifier to improve accuracy. For this, the Cleveland heart samples taken from the UCI repository. Experiment results show that the proposed FTP model achieves 93.49% accuracy. Without FTP, the RF, and LM achieve only 88.20% and 63.60% accuracy. We also present the hyper-parameter tuning of the classifier with significant features in the result section.

articleTitle: A PV-WEC Based Microgrid System incorporating Hybrid Islanding Detection Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper investigates the aspects of microgrid formed with distributed energy sources such as Photo Voltaic (PV) solar and wind. Detecting Islanding in a microgrid has become a major challenge in electrical power systems. This project proposes a combination of three islanding detection method, namely voltage unbalance (VU), total harmonic distortion (THD) from passive method and Sandia frequency shift (SFS) from active method. The proposed strategy consolidates the benefits of both active and passive techniques. Moreover, since this project uses the benefits of the SFS method it will not change the system variables and will not lead instability due to any disturbance.

articleTitle: Design Study on Traction Motors for Hybrid Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In Hybrid Electric Vehicles a high power electric motor/generator and an electrical storage system are used for tractive power in addition to the conventional Internal Combustion Engine (ICE). Several topologies of electrical machines can be used to meet the various requirements in a Hybrid Electric Vehicle. This paper describes the process of an electric motor-generator selection, considering electromagnetic, thermal and basic control design.

articleTitle: Power Coordination System between Multiple Sources in Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study presents a power management scheme for application in hybrid electric vehicle (EV) systems. For various advantageous features like, high efficiency, and high reliability photovoltaic (PV) system is chosen as the main power source of EV. However, according to mitigate the intermittency problem of solar cell, auxiliary source is required to be incorporated along with PV. Hence, an energy storage system (Battery) is associated with the PV system which can ensure an uninterrupted power supply. Through the bidirectional DC-DC converter battery cells are used to store excess solar energy and provide them to the load when required. As per requirement the battery is charged and discharged by controlling the operation mode of the bidirectional converter i.e. bucking and boosting, respectively. The MATLAB simulation results are presented to show the behavior of the responses even in presence of variation in load as well as in different illumination condition of PV module.

articleTitle: TBSC Compensator for Reactive Power Compensation along with Transient Free Switching of Capacitor Bank
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A method for compensation of reactive power along with transient free switching of capacitor bank is presented in this paper. The system based on Thyristor Binary Switched Capacitor (TBSC) banks which are nothing but the set of Thyristor Switched Capacitor (TSC) banks for compensation. These are placed in binary sequence to give approximate continuous compensation of reactive power. The switching of TBSC bank is transient free which is to be carried out in closed loop system. The objective of this paper is to provide a minimum cost topology for compensation of reactive power at load end by the Thyristor Binary Switched Capacitor (TBSC) bank. In this paper, simulation results of this method are presented. The step less reactive power compensation is achieved and due to filtering action of TBSC the harmonic content at source side is reduced.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experimental Study of Self-Excited Slip-Ring Induction Generator with Variable Capacitance and Rotor Resistance
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents, a simplified equivalent circuit of self-excited slip ring induction generator (SESRIG) to obtain the steady state characteristics. The combination of nodal admittance method and real power balance approach reduced the circuit complexity. The performance of SESRIG has been verified experimentally with variable speed condition. The effect of variation of rotor resistance and excitation capacitance on magnitude and frequency of voltage for an extensive range of speed is discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Ride-Through of Doubly Fed Induction Generator based Wind Energy Conversion System incorporating Step Resistive Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper proposes a step resistive fault current limiter (SRFCL) for the low voltage ride-through of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) operated wind conversion system (WCS) against fault. The incorporation of SRFCL effectively restricts the uncertainties concerns of the fault like rotor over current, stator over current, DC-Link over voltage and torque oscillations. The efficacy of the proposed scheme is compared with the traditional resistive super conducting fault current limier (R-SFCL) and conventional vector control scheme (VCS). The proposed scheme reveals better effectiveness compared to traditional R-SFCL and VCS. The scheme also claims the achievement with minimum occurrence of switching operation with lower losses. The model is being simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK based environment

articleTitle: Investigation of Harmonic resonance analysis in a grid connected wind farm
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, investigation of harmonic resonance analysis has been done for grid connected wind farm. Different types of harmonic resonances are considered and their impact on the grid has been investigated. The presence of capacitor banks in the grid system and size of the capacitor bank in generation of harmonic resonance has been thoroughly investigated and also the voltage distortion in the grid supply is analyzed for different operating modes. The proposed work has been done as a case study for a 200 MW wind farm. The proposed work has been implemented using DigSilent software and simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of Separately Excited DC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Power Rectifiers are mainly employed in power system to convert AC power into controlled DC power. Since DC motors are very commonly broadly used in several industrial areas due to their simple and adjustable characteristics. With help of power electronics controllers, its regulation and handling become very simple and accurate. But contrary on other hand due to the over integration of these devices, problems regarding power factor and harmonic distortion (T.H.D) turn out to be a prominent concern. In this paper, AC power fed to DC motor drive is controlled and regulated by several controllers which includes thyristor- based converters with different pulse width modulation technique along various filters to reduce total harmonic distortions.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Air Pollutants in Ambient Air, Reality of Sensors and Corrective Measures in India
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Due to rapid increase in the population of India, the nation is at an urge to fulfil the needs of the entire population which has led to increase in urbanization, industrialization, deforestation, etc., that further has paved a way to increase in air pollution. Though the needs are fulfilled to some extent, the polluted air has a serious effect on the health of the human as well as the environment. This is the right time to walk through and understand the various sources of pollution, their effects on health of mankind and environment. This paper focusses on describing the various fundamental sources of air pollution, their threat towards the health of human and the guideline provided for those pollutants. We have also collected the concentration of the major air pollutants namely SO2, NO2 and Particulate Matter PM10 at various states of India using the monitoring stations' data and a statistical analysis of the same is performed to identify the air quality index of the ambient air based on which the harmful effects are predicted. Also we have discussed the reality of the various sensors available for monitoring the concentration of air pollutants in the ambient air and the control measures that could be taken to reduce the concentration to safeguard the population from the threat.

articleTitle: Simulation of Burst Phenomenon in Exploding Wire
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Explosive Magnetic Generators (EMGs) are the pulsed power sources which use explosives as their prime power sources. In the power conditioning system of a Magnetic Flux Compression Generator (MFCG), the key role is played by Exploding Wire. This paper presents the modelling and simulation of the exploding wire behaviour, incorporating the impact of skin effect in the wire, using two different approaches to resistivity change during the process till the burst phenomenon. Understanding this behaviour of exploding wire helps in designing a proper conditioning system for MFCGs.

articleTitle: Accurate detection of islanding and fault in distributed generation using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper proposes accurate detection of the islanding condition in a highly wind power penetrated distributed generation system. Wavelet transform is chosen as a suitable tool for discriminate between islanding event, fault condition and power quality disturbances. Using wavelet transform energy and standard deviation has been computed for different cases such as addition and removal of different energy sources, different loading conditions, different types of faults and islanding situations in distributed generations. Finally a threshold value is selected for energy to discriminate accurately islanding condition and other power quality events.

articleTitle: Continuous Monitoring of DC Motor using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this day and age the applications of electrical machines are diverse and overall quite advantageous due to which, we have to make sure that the machines themselves are well maintained and operating efficiently. In this paper a LabVIEW model has been presented which carries out continuous monitoring of the separately excited dc motor, and shows its real time performance characteristics. This is achieved by using Data Acquisition System (DAQ) and LabVIEW version 2017.

articleTitle: A Solution for Stability Improvement through Compressed Air Energy Storage as Reactive Power Compensating Device under Various Grid Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Grid stability can be improved by implementing various energy storage devices in the power system and among them one of the storage system is compressed air energy storage system (CAES). This CAES can be used for management of variation in the renewable energy and grid demand. The only drawback with CAES is that its cost is high compared with other storage technologies. The research is under development to operate CAES in an most efficient and economic way with maximum utilization of energy stored with least thermal losses. In this paper CAES is used for meeting the reactive power for the wind farm when it is subjected to fault at different bus locations. Here an doubly fed induction generator(DFIG) based wind turine(WT) with CAES performance shows better than static var compensator(SVC). This shows that CAES can be used as reactive power source for improving the system performance in the case of stability.

articleTitle: Efficient Retrieval of Data from Cloud Databases using Hash Partitioned Buckets
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cloud computing has become a cornerstone of development during this era of computing. More and more users are turning to the cloud services provided by the third party service providers at cheaper costs and high availability. But protection and privacy of the data stored in the cloud is still a major concern since the users data is being controlled by a third -party in between. Encryption becomes an obvious choice though but is is still questionable on how well the data in its encrypted form can be managed at the cloud . We have proposed a method of applying partitioning techniques on the encrypted structured database in cloud . We have used the hash partitioning technique to partition our database. Our proposed method is compared against a traditional coding table method and it is found to be comaparitively efficient in terms of the running time of the queries.

articleTitle: An Amalgamation of Three Modulus Method and LSB4 Image Encryption Technique for Hiding text in an Image
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, we have proposed a stenographic algorithm that advantageously disguises an instant message inside an image. The hidden message is concealed in the cover image using an amalgamation of a hybrid Least Significant Bit method and Three Modulus characters by character encryption. The entire encryption methodology is secured by a password such that only the designated receiver can decrypt the hidden message from the cover image.

articleTitle: User Preference Based Community Categorization Towards Video Recommendation Using Kolam Structure In Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A community in a network can be defined as a dense sub graph that is loosely linked to other communities. A social network graph contains nodes representing actors (generally people or organizations) and edges representing relationships or communications between the actors. Community Detection aims to divide the graph into different subsets, but an entity may belong to more than one community in reality. The existing video recommendation systems use artificial neural networks to implement the recommendation system. Kolam is a geometrical drawing consisting of lines and curves that runs around each point to form a pattern. We propose a novel method for community detection and video recommendation using the Kolam patterns considering it as a data structure.

articleTitle: VSC Based Modular Multilevel Converter For Grid Applications Using PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multi-level converters have gained a reputation in both Medium-Voltage and Low-Voltage applications. To find out the connections among several multilevel Voltage Source Converter (VSC) topologies and to expose in what way to attain innovative topologies. Between them, VSC attained the main market share and taken obvious improvements in the earlier time. The most topical developments in the VSCs is a Modular Multi-level Converter (M-MC). This configuration has a modular structure; power rating and voltage of the converter can be enlarged by accumulating the Sub-Modules (SM) in series. This paper presents the VSC based M-MC of high power converters, which the controller controls the voltage on the load using a PI controller. The simulation results of converter voltage, converter current, grid voltage, grid current, PI error voltage, three-phase instantaneous real power, and reactive power obtained to justify the achievement of the suggested topology.

articleTitle: Single-Stage Multifunction Multilevel Converter for Grid Interactive Photovoltaic System using Cascaded Two-level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a single-stage multilevel converter for grid interactive Photovoltaic (PV) system using a Cascaded Two-Level Inverter (CTLI). The converter uses less number of switches, less isolated DC sources and no extra components like capacitors and diodes which are used in conventional multilevel inverters (MLIs). The CTLI based grid tied Photovoltaic system tracks the maximum power produced by the PV array under varying insolation conditions and injects the active power into the grid. Additionally, the PV system is able to perform the reactive power compensation along with harmonics elimination for nonlinear load within the capacity of inverter. These multi-functionality increases overall utilization of the system. The control scheme of the CTLI based grid interactive PV system is developed using instantaneous power (p-q) theory. The control of CTLI based multifunctional grid interactive PV system is verified through MATLAB/Simulink simulations. The simulation results validate the performance of CTLI based grid tied PV system for MPPT as well as active and reactive power control for changing insolation and load conditions.

articleTitle: Back EMF Noise Band based Initial Startup Scheme for Sensorless Operation of BLDC drive
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper a back EMF noise based sensorless startup algorithm has been proposed and verified with hardware. The proposed startup technique provides fast startup without reverse rotation. The detected line to line back EMF is detected from line to line terminal voltage using least Pth norm IIR filter designed inside NI-PCI6221 controller. This compared to a speed proportional band for getting phase back EMF zero difference points. During the standstill, acquisition noises are present in the system in place of back EMFs. Pulses with varying frequency and frequency ramp up rate are obtained after comparison to speed proportional band. Phase energization pulses are released when frequency has lower value and frequency ramp up rate of these pulses is positive. However when back EMF increases as motor moves, the band increases and pulse frequency reduces. The proposed system has been tested with realtime implementation.

articleTitle: Development of LabVIEW front end for a fault injection capable synchronous generator
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In modern industries condition monitoring is of great importance and researchers have been developing various algorithms for condition monitoring of equipment. Synchronous generators are the central component in any power station. For testing the condition monitoring algorithms for generators fault injection capable test beds are required. In order that the researchers interact with the fault injection capable synchronous generator in an efficient manner, a good user interface is required. In this work, the requirements of such a user interface are listed and implemented on an actual fault injection capable synchronous generator [8]. LabVIEW has been used to implement the user interface. The work also describes the data acquisition system and signal conditioning used. This work will be of great help to future researchers in this research area for developing fault injection capable systems, especially for electrical machines.

articleTitle: Secure Data Transmission in Heterogeneous Smart Meter Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Smart grid communication undergoes security threats issues that affects the hierarchical data transfer. The proposed work focuses on secured data transmission in heterogeneous Smart meter to DCU communication through a gateway. Attack detection, key exchange and authentication of Smart meter to DCU communication are analyzed for heterogeneous Smart meter Environment. The data forwarding is done with the help of AODV.Hash and EXor algorithm is used for detecting attacks. Diffie -Hellman key exchange is opted for key exchange. Elliptic Curve Integrated Encryption Scheme is used for authentication. The parameters such as throughput and packet delivery ratio are analyzed for Heterogeneous SM environment. Our result for computation time based on the number of iterations performed by SHA-256 and SHA-512 in heterogeneous environment performs better in terms of computation and communication times.The Proposed work enables a suitable design for security algorithm in the smart grid communication.

articleTitle: Investigation of LabVIEW and Syslog Interface using In-house Developed Generic Logging Software
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Status logging using standards such as Syslog is widely recommended and used across various industry verticals. LabVIEW is a widely used data acquisition and control platform for scientific experiments. The integration of LabVIEW and Syslog technologies for status, error and event logging is a topic of considerable interest. This paper discusses the investigation of interface and development of a generic logger software in LabVIEW which provides facility to record messages formatted in RFC 3164 format into a syslog server and benchmark the performance of data transfer. Motivation of this work is driven by machine control system mandate of the large volume plasma device but on larger domain, this can be used in applications concerned to the log management for scientific experiments. The paper discusses motivation, literature survey, software development artifacts and benchmarking results.

articleTitle: An Efficient Energy Management System For Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Micro-Grids (MG) are an optimistic technology that can maximize the reliability and economic aspects of energy supply to end consumers. Renewable based power generation is the only option for governments to solve the huge problems of power demand and emissions. This paper, particularly focuses on Wind and Photo-Voltaic (PV) based hybrid power generation. The Energy Management System (EMS) plays a major role to fulfil the load demand also it provides stable operation. Here, EMS for MG incorporating Wind and PV based on hybrid optimization technique which is named as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA). The proposed technique is used to enhance the efficiency of the system and reduces the overall cost of the system. The simulation results show the improved performance of hybrid PSO-CSA algorithm compared with the traditional algorithm, which validates the efficacy of this optimization technique.

articleTitle: An Utilized Method of Passive Cooling in Nuclear Reactor
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Natural circulation loops (NCLs) give a very well planned of removing heat from a peak-temperature source to a nadir temperature sink in the absence of using any automatic device. That the principle of the circulating fluid, heated from lower end and cooled from higher end, to flow under the impact of gravity, the difference in fluid density between the two vertical arms being the driving force. Flow under natural circulation is basically less stable and it created instabilities, The heat supplied by the heater created the buoyancy force and flow of the fluid in the NCL. If heating power in heater will increase the flow rate of the fluid is also increase. On further heating to the heater, the cooled fluid enter to the riser section and the buoyancy forces reduced.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Foil Wound Pulse Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Explosive Magnetic Generators (EMGs) are the pulsed power sources which use explosives as their prime power sources. In the power conditioning system of a Magnetic Flux Compression Generator (MFCG), the key role is played by Pulse Transformer. This paper presents modelling of a Foil Wound Pulse Transformer using Ansys Maxwell Software. The results of simulation show the impact of different loading conditions on the output of Pulse Transformer.

articleTitle: 3-Phase Modular PFC Converter for High Voltage Gain Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A new modular three phase topology is proposed for Power Factor Correction (PFC) that features high voltage gain. This proposed three phase converter consists of switched capacitor cell in each module. In the proposed topology, all components have voltage stress equal to half of the output voltage. This converter features modular structure, less voltage stress across the active components, high voltage gain, good power factor. Average current control is implemented to have unity power factor and low harmonic distortion. MATLAB/SIMULINK study has been carried out to ascertain the performance of the proposed converter.

articleTitle: Protection Algorithm for PV Based Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Small scale energy requirement is met by distributed network energy resources (DNERs). Renewables are gaining much importance when compared to conventional one due to their cleanliness. For the safe operation of grid connected and islanded mode of operation protection coordination intervals are designed correctly. As the number of PV based DNERs increase the magnitude of fault current will decrease. It provides the greater challenge to power system engineers if exceeds the loading limits. To limit the effect of fault magnitude a protection algorithm is designed. A voltage and current based protection algorithm is presented which can accurately discriminate between the fault during utility ties and islanded modes of operation. The new algorithm is implemented in standard IEEE 9 bus reference system.

Author Keywords: Voltage-current time inverse relay features and distribution network (DN)

articleTitle: System identification based Plant Model Estimation of Friction Stir Welding Process for joining Aluminium Metal Matrix Composites
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Friction Stir Welding is more feasible welding technique for joining of Aluminium Metal Matrix Composites owing to its greater demand in aerospace and automobile sectors. The main goal in FSW is to generate enough thermal energy by friction between the workpiece and rotating tool. Heat energy is generated due to mechanical interaction because of the difference in velocity between the workpiece and rotating tool. The FSW process undergoes several process transients and disturbances during welding operation. Control systems play a vital role in tuning and modifying press parameters of FSW process to obtain good quality joint. Before hardware development of controllers, it is always essential to design and test the control schemes. To evaluate a controller, a plant model on which is acts is essential. The concept of System Identification paves a way to estimate the plant model using experimental data. Initially, the Al-MMC composites are prepared at four combinations of SiC and B4C reinforcements and welded at three level parameter settings followed by tensile testing and Hardness. The tool-workpiece interface temperature is recorded during welding using DAQ system. All the experimental data are merged and used to estimate the plant transfer function model.

articleTitle: Analysis on Performance of MCPWM Techniques for a Multilevel Inverter fed PV system
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper focuses on control design of single-phase hexagonal switch cell multilevel inverter (HSCMLI) interconnected with photovoltaic (PV) array. The new hexagonal switch cell multilevel inverter uses a reduced number of power semiconductor devices as compared with conventional multilevel inverter (MLI) topologies. The proposed topology reduces the size, complexity and improves the reliability of the overall PV system. It can also generate 7, 9 and 11 level using only 7 switches. To improve the performance of the inverter output various multi-carrier pulse width modulation (MCPWM) techniques demonstrated successfully using MATLAB/Simulink environment to enhance the fundamental output voltage and total harmonic distortion (THD). The power extracted through the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) technique. A 3 KW hardware setup with two DC-DC boost converter has been proposed and tested using dSPACE DS 1103. The correct operation of the proposed topology shows that the carrier overlap technique offers better result compared to other MCPWM techniques.

articleTitle: Solar Integrated Electric Spring for Hospital ICU
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Global warming and climate changes are severe problems faced by the humanity. Increase in use of fossil fuels is one of the main reason behind global warming. One way to reduce the use of fossil fuel is to go for Renewable Energy Sources (RES) and nowadays RES have become the key element in micro grids. The operation of RES depends on physical parameters like wind velocity, solar radiation level etc. The intermittent nature of RES causes voltage instability and power quality issues in the grid and will affect the operation of electrical/electronic equipments. Electric spring is an efficient technique at distributive level to improve system power quality. Combined operation of non sensitive loads and electric spring can control the voltage across sensitive loads. In this paper, solar integrated electric spring is modelled for hospital intensive care unit and the operation of the model is evaluated under different operating conditions like sag, swell, transient load conditions and harmonic conditions. The system is modelled and analyzed in MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study and Prediction of Flashover Voltage of 11kV Bushing with Various Pollutions using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In transmission and distribution, the reliability of the power system is affected by many reasons. Among them, the pollution flashovers, occurring on high voltage bushings are main reasons. When they are exposed to various environmental conditions, the pollution deposited on the surface of the bushing may be non-uniformly. This deposited pollution may affect surface flashover voltage and leakage current greatly which degrades the insulation properties of bushing and affects their electrical characteristics. In this proposed work, the performance of bushing with non-uniform pollution was studied. According to IEC 60507, artificial pollution method was done to conduct laboratory based pollution performance test on bushings. The NaCl salt and kaolin mixture in different ratio with three equal intervals was coated by using brushing method. The levels of SDD and NSDD are noted for both normal bushing and RTV coated bushing of 11kV air and oil bushings. The results shows that the flashover voltage gets reduced when the T/B ratio increases and the performance of RTV coated bushing has better results.

articleTitle: Optimization of Fabrication Parameters on Hybrid Fibre Reinforced Polymer Composite by ANN Design
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Natural fiber based composites fabricated usually posses low strength and finds less use in automotives. Hybridization with stronger synthetic fibers like carbon or glass improves the strength. Composites prepared with synthetic fibers as outer layers and natural fibers as inner core shall serve in automotives. This work explodes the potential reinforcement of fibers from palm fruit for fabricating polymer composites. The fibers were pre-treated with glass fibers to form as fiber mats and hybridized with glass fibers prior to reinforcement. These mats were reinforced in the polyester resin matrix as different layers to form a hybrid composite. Experiments were done by varying the length of fiber, fiber volume and with different treatments using response surface methodology. Tensile strength was measured as response. The tensile strength was spotted maximum in 8% potassium permanganate (KMnO4) treated palm fibers with optimum fiber length 40 mm and volume fraction of 20%. The surface study on these composites through SEM (Scanning Electron Microscope) examination was satisfactory. Hence this specimen combination was best suited and recommended to manufacture components like car bonnet, bumper etc.

articleTitle: Solution to Unit Commitment Using Lagrange Relaxation with Whale Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The unit commitment is an optimization problem which aims at optimal scheduling of generators subjected to different constraints such as power balance, minimum uptime and down time etc. A novel Lagrange Relaxation with whale optimization algorithm (LR-WOA) has been developed for solving unit commitment problem. In order to prove the superiority over other conventional methods, IEEE 10 unit 24 hour system is taken and solved using LR- WOA optimization algorithm and compared with other conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Notification of Cardiovascular Accident using Android Sensors and GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this research paper we aim to approach the problem of early detection of cardiovascular accident (CVA) or what is commonly known as stroke, from a signal analysis standpoint. On the extensive frequency and waveform analysis of various stroke victims we found that there is an extension of the QRS complex before the stroke is about to strike. Using this as an indication we have developed a system, to warn the next of kin and emergency services so that the victim maybe treated within the golden hour and the effects of the stroke be reversed. QRS waveforms present the most amount of information that can be used for the detection of cardiovascular infractions. The time interval of the various elements of QRS waveform can be interpreted to give us information about the cardiovascular health. This waveform as seen from [1] can be easily obtained in the form of ECG signals and several analysis techniques have been developed to remove noise from such signal to obtain pure ECG signal. Our study and the development of the prototype is based on such analysis of the ECG signal where the RR interval is taken into account as the primary variable for the detection of cardiovascular attacks.

articleTitle: Modelling and Efficiency Analysis of Microwave Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Microwave based Wireless Power Transfer or Microwave power transfer system (MPTS) is the emerging area in which electrical power is transferred from source to load without any wired connection. MPTS transfers the power between transmitter and receiver maintaining high efficiency even if the distance is very long which makes this technology superior to all the other type of wireless power transfer (WPT) technologies. The MPT system works by converting electrical power to microwaves using a microwave generator and then transmitting it into free space where it is received and converted back to electrical power by a special device called a rectenna. There are various methods to enhance the transmission efficiency, such as improving the gain of antenna, minimizing the conversion losses by optimizing the diode and impedance matching circuit. In this paper, modeling of MPT system is illustrated closely and then the efficiency of the system is investigated and elaborated for each component to compute the overall efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Diesel Engine Control and Protection Monitoring using PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper deals with the development of a Simulink model for the control, protection and monitoring system of a diesel engine. Various sensors and switches involved in the engine protection and monitoring systems such as throttle position sensor (TPS), lube oil pressure sensor (OPS), coolant temperature sensor (CTS) and idle validation switch (IVS) are discussed in detail. Then, a comparison study of the speed control of the diesel engine was done using P, PI and PID controllers. Finally, a mathematical model of the diesel engine is derived using the System Identification Technique. The results obtained by formulating an accurate mathematical model and a precise controller allow the operator to establish the required engine protection parameters such as the coolant temperature, oil pressure and the speed of the engine.

articleTitle: Battery Management Systems for Electric Vehicles using Lithium Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric Vehicle technology plays an important role in greenhouse gas limitation and carbon pollutions. Rechargeable batteries are used to deliver power to the auxiliary systems and motor in the electric vehicle applications. Various classifications of rechargeable batteries are available nowadays, for electric vehicle applications. Among all rechargeable batteries, Lithium Ion Batteries will give high efficiency for electric mobility because Li-Ion batteries have low self-discharge rate, wide operating range, maximum energy density and high life cycle. To improve the quality of battery and safe operation, battery management system is employed and it plays a vital role in application of Electric Mobility. This paper reviews the attributes of battery management system and its technology with advantages and disadvantages for electric vehicle application. This review includes the battery cell monitoring, state estimation, charging and discharging control, temperature control, fault analysis, data acquisition and protection schemes to improve the performance of battery for EV applications.

articleTitle: Job Recommender Systems: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: From the last two decades internet based recruiting platforms have become a primary channel in most companies for recruiting talents. Such portals decrease the advertisement cost, but they suffer from information overload problem. Job portals using traditional information retrieval techniques such as Boolean search methods are typically using simple word matching algorithms. The main issue of these portals is their inability to understand the complexity of matching between candidates' desires and organizations' requirements. Hence, a vast amount of deserving candidates misses the opportunity to get an appropriate job. The recent recommender systems have achieved success in e-commerce applications. In order to improve the functionality of e-recruitment process, many recommendation systems approaches have been proposed. In this paper, we present a survey of existing recommendation approaches that have been used for building the personalized recommendation systems for job seekers as well as recruiters. Also we have identified the challenges in building a job recruitment system as compared to recommendation systems in other domain.

articleTitle: A Review on Microgrids with Distributed Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In association with increasing in penetration of distributed generation sources (DGs) into power systems, and their power management of different DGs and the grid has elevated as a major concern. Though, Microgrid (MG) is the extensively an accepted concept for the association of DGs in power system networks. Integrating renewable energy sources (RESs), which are often connected via power electronic interfaces into the power grid, can sometimes be a stimulating task just from a purely technical point of view. Thus, the MG is a promising option for future power system interfaces. Evolving the challenges has taken place in terms of the power system control, power quality improvement, reliability, and energy management. The MG operational performance, stability, basic control issues and, concept of MGs are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A Survey on Video Summarization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: With the quick development of digital video technology, it is possible to upload large videos to YouTube or any other websites, record huge amount of data as news videos, sports videos, and lecture videos and surveillance videos etc. Storage, transfer and processing of video take considerably large amount of time. The user might not have adequate time to watch enter video before downloading or the user needs the search result of video to be quick and precise. In such cases the highlight or summary of the video makes search and indexing operations fast and user can view the highlight or summary of the video before downloading the video.Video summarization is short summary or highlights of the long video. This work is a detailed study on various video summarization techniques.

articleTitle: A Novel Optimization Method for Parameter Extraction of Industrial Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Triple diode model is used in the present work for making a lumped parameter equivalent circuit for solar photovoltaic (PV) model. Flower pollination optimization algorithm (FPOA) is used for finding out various parameters of the solar cell. The theoretical values considering the estimation are not the same as the industrial samples of double diode model. Many current components of solar cells were not found by the two diode model correctly whereas a triple diode model can extract the data accurately. The FPOA is being used to extract different parameters of the given triple diode model. The success of the FPOA optimization process is that it performs the local and global search within the single stage to extract the parameters. Simulation is carried out and the performance of the FPOA is compared with two other optimization techniques such as differential evolution (DE) method and particle swarm optimization (PSO) method. Comparison result shows that the triple diode model including FPOA provides superior performance than the double and single diode model. Moreover, huge silicon solar cells could be explained easily by the triple diode model.

articleTitle: Applications of AI for Power Electronics and Drives Systems: A Review
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Tools of Artificial Intelligence (AI) like Fuzzy Logic (FL), Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and some other like Genetic Algorithm (GA) etc. have brought gyration in power electronics systems. The target of AI is to catalyze intelligence in system so that it can adapt to changes automatically. Advance problems can be simply resolved by AI techniques which are troublesome to solve by other means. The fuzzy controller is extensively utilized in converters, controllers, ac, dc and reluctance motor drives, PWM inverters, and plenty of other applications. The neural network has been utilized in rectifier regulator. Expert systems are used for training algorithms used in automation systems. This paper contains an overview and introduction to above described tools and their applications in Harmonic detection and elimination, Current source inverters, Power electronics expert Systems, Photovoltaic systems etc. Recent development of powerful FPGAs and DSPs is creating practical implementation of fuzzy and neural systems more economics friendly with improvement of quality performance.

articleTitle: An Overview of Residential Demand Side Management Strategies
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Demand side management abbreviated as DSM is a methodology which will be useful in meeting out the growing load demand without considerably increasing the generation capacity. DSM is a control strategy which re-schedules or curtails the electric loads present in the customer premises in order to achieve certain benefits. In most of the cases DSM is used to curtail the non-critical loads during peak hours and shift them to off-peak hours of the day based on the cost of electricity. DSM can be implemented to industrial, residential and commercial customers based on the requirements of the utility and support provided by the consumers. This study presents an overview on the residential demand side management techniques used for home energy management.

articleTitle: Antlion optimization and Whale optimization Algorithm for multilevel thresholding segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multi-level image segmentation is a critical task in image processing that involves multiple threshold values. As the high computational cost of an exhaustive search is inefficient and cumbersome, the optimal thresholds algorithms make for a better path to venture; hence a comparison of optimization algorithms to set the optimal thresholds is highly essential and beneficial. In this paper, a practical comparison is made to deduce the best optimization technique amongst the whale optimization and antlion optimization algorithm, to solve the multilevel threshold problem, to find the optimal multilevel thresholds. Otsu's function is maximized to perform optimized thresholding-based image segmentation. The experimental results showed that the Antlion optimization algorithm gave better performance in solving the problem for higher level multi-thresholding.

articleTitle: Linearly Homomorphic Signature Based Secure Computation Outsourcing in Vehicular Adhoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In vehicular adhoc network (VANET), periodic messages, known as beacons, are transmitted by vehicles to their neighboring vehicles and surrounding RSU to help them create a logical map of surrounding environment. For ensuring the correctness of this map, beacon messages must be source authenticated to protect the network from bogus and fake messages from attacker vehicles. Further, end user of the beacon messages who performs analysis of beacons would be interested in outsourcing this activity to the third party such as RSU so as to free itself from keeping dedicated computational and bandwidth resources. Therefore, messages should be signed in a manner such that computations performed by RSU are verifiable to the end user without having access to the actual messages and their signature on which computation is performed. In this paper, we implement an efficient linearly homomorphic signature scheme to sign beacon messages such that computations can be performed over them by a third party. The computation results are verifiable to the subscribed users having access to only pseudo identity of the signer vehicle. Our scheme meets the security feature of signature unforgeability and provides required services of authentication and non-repudiation.
